name: the-commons
description: The Commons — dependencies needed by the Netlify Functions in netlify/functions/. Without this file, Netlify has nothing telling it to install @netlify/blobs before deploying the functions, and every function that imports it (save-event, get-events, save-avatar, get-avatar, RSVPs, friends) fails at runtime with "Cannot find module '@netlify/blobs'". "type": "module" tells Node these are ES modules (import/export, which every function file already uses) instead of guessing at each one — without it, Node still works but prints a harmless "MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON" warning for every function it loads.
